name: Block ID Prompt
description: Prompt for custom block IDs and complete wiki block links to open tasks, with a plan-budget suffix. Ctrl+Shift+Enter refuses Depends-On ⛓️ **DEPENDS ON:** dependency lines. On inbox notes, Ctrl+Shift+Enter asks where the task goes before linking or unlinking, then moves it with the toggle applied (nav inboxRoute v1).
author: Bryan
